entries.scene: The interior of Diamond Dogs' QUARANTINE PLATFORM in The Phantom Pain. Match only the pictured industrial hall: flat metal flooring with two parallel blue guidance lines, dark ribbed steel partitions and mesh/metal gates in the back, paired large pale vertical plumbing pipes with ring couplers on the right, pipes along the low ceiling, a plain green-grey heavy rectangular steel door with a small wired-glass window as in the second reference, subdued orange emergency lighting and smoky amber haze. Empty architecture with all people and bodies omitted. NOT the Cyprus hospital: no hospital beds, no curtains, no normal hospital corridors. Keep the industrial materials, muted palette and visible structural proportions of the real game references.
